title: External verifier receipt required for reviewed training traces
$comment: Version 2 adds canonical task-input binding and complete indexed outcomes. Migrate by exporting real verifier execution results; do not fabricate outcomes or mechanically mark prior count-only receipts valid.
description: An existing result produced by the actual environment verifier. The preparer checks binding and consistency but does not replay or authenticate the verifier. Keep privileged verifier details outside model-visible messages/tools.

checks_total.description: Must equal the complete verifier-list length for this task in the current normalized evaluator_only/train.jsonl contract.

checks_passed.description: Must equal checks_total; no empty or omitted check set can pass.

task_input_sha256.description: Canonical public training input hash: task_id, domain, system_prompt, user_prompt, selected_tools, restricted_tools. UTF8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, no NaN.

verifier_contract_sha256.description: SHA256 of UTF8 canonical JSON of the entire task verifiers LIST, including normalized names: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, no NaN. Not the hash of a {verifiers:...} wrapper.

outcomes.description: Exactly one real result for each zero-based verifier index. Names must match the normalized list at that index. All required outcomes must pass without errors. No missing or duplicate indexes.
